label: Update gate dips at D1 after an a1 choice rarely reached S2, most if unrewarded.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * ep_dec
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 43 sits near 1 almost always; its variance beyond timing is a D1-specific drop after the previous trial was a1 -> S2 (rare transition): about -0.10 for any outcome, a further -0.07 if unrewarded (a1 S2 u, total ~-0.17); D1 after reaching S1 is slightly higher (+0.02). GO and D2 barely vary (|residual| < 0.01). The free fit adds belief_lo (lower when S1 believed good), repeated a1 S2 u streaks deepening the dip, and growth late in the episode, but scores no better than the short form on dev (0.63 vs 0.64). Remaining misses: occasional deep D1 dips late in episodes after a1 S1 u. Uses observed variables only.

issues: The label leaves out the third short-form term, (phase==D1)*(prev_state==1), which is +0.020 and worth 0.036 test R^2 (0.594 without it, 0.630 with it). D1 after reaching S1 sits slightly above baseline. This is minor because the main effect is the dip.

Every claim checks out in the profile. D1 residual: a1 S2 r -0.098, a1 S2 u -0.165, all other previous trials +0.006 to +0.028. GO and D2 residuals stay under 0.01. Fitted weights are -0.100 for a1->S2, a further -0.067 when unrewarded, and +0.020 after reaching S1.

Alternatives scored on test, none better: prev_action==2 as the third term 0.624; belief_lo at D1 0.604; a1 x ep_dec 0.601; a1 x unrewarded instead of a1 S2 u 0.618; a two-trial a1 S2 streak 0.616. Swapping prev_state==2 for prev_common==0 gives the same fit (0.630), because a1->S2 is by definition the rare transition.

Misses on the short form show no large systematic class. The biggest cell bias is D1 after a2 S2 r, under-predicted by +0.019. The deep late-episode D1 dips after a1 S1 u (about 0.70 against a predicted 0.97) are rare: that cell's mean error is only -0.006. The short form scores 0.63 against an observed additive ceiling of 0.71.
